weight_band.note: how far a learned record may move the AUTHORED transaction_weight from trust_ladder.json. It must contain 1.0: the operator's number is the anchor, and competence moves the weight inside the range the operator allowed, never outside it

demo.thermal-forecast.note: same quantity and the same prediction field the coverage audit reads (calibration.example.json). alpha is the OPERATOR's level, not the coverage the peer claims: a peer allowed to pick its own would lower it to make misses cheap, since the interval score's miss penalty is 2/alpha

demo.power-forecast.note: scale is one unit of loss in the quantity's own units, and it is required: a guessed scale would silently decide how much a watt matters against a degree

demo.track-forecast.note: a 3-component quantity; the interval score is the mean over components, so a vector forecast is not three times worse than a scalar one
